messages:
taylor: Customer flagged duplicated token charges when a streaming request retried after a route swap. Minimal repro attached.
mohit: Can you paste the trace lines? suspect ephemeral session cleared on swap.
taylor: Trace snippet: ```2026-04-12T02:14:01Z stream EOF seq=768; emitted toolcall id=tool-42; 2026-04-12T02:14:02Z router swap -> clear-ephemeral; 2026-04-12T02:14:02Z client reconnect replay -> toolcall id=tool-42-R```
rebecca: Two paths: (A) force clients to send session_id/idempotency token on retries (longer term), or (B) server-side fingerprint dedupe for provisional billing as fallback.
mohit: Proposal for (B): compute fingerprint = sha256(normalized_tool_payload + tool_name + customer_id); only suppress if fingerprint matches AND prior event state == PROVISIONAL AND reconnect_delta < 500ms OR route_swap flag present.
taylor: Important: preserve raw events immutably. Create a suppression record linking the duplicate to the original; do not delete. That enables billing replay if needed.
rebecca: Telemetry: emit fields dedupe.applied=true|false, dedupe.fingerprint, dedupe.reason, dedupe.suppressed=true|false, dedupe.trace_link. Keep an audit table with both events and suppression records.
console-team: UX asks: label suppressed provisional charges with a small badge "Suppressed (heuristic)"; hover explains "server heuristic temporarily suppressed duplicate provisional charge"; add "View trace" and "Request audit" buttons. Also add filter for suppressed items.
ops-bot: Add feature-flag "retry_provisional_dedupe" and per-customer opt-out tag `no_server_prov_dedupe`. Canary plan required.
mohit: Tests: unit tests for fingerprint collisions + integration with route-swap and reconnect simulations. Backfill fingerprints for 7 days to estimate accidental collision rate before enabling suppression.
taylor: Alert criteria: suppression_rate > 0.25% of retries OR confirmed_charge_delta increases post-rollout. Also track suppressed_count / total_retry_count.
rebecca: Doc note: suppression only affects billing events; it does not prevent duplicate remote side-effects if the retry actually executed. Document recommended client idempotency patterns for downstream tool implementers.
console-team: We'll mock UI copy and wire the trace link to the dedupe.trace_link. Plan to surface this in billing console as an annotation and filter.
mohit: I'll own server patch + canary. ETA: 10 business days. rebecca: I'll own telemetry + dashboards. ETA: 4 days. console-team: prototyping next sprint.
ops-bot: RW-10214 created: "retry provisional dedupe + audit UI". Canary scheduled: 2026-04-19 08:00 UTC (5% traffic).
taylor: Please add toggles for annotate-only mode (show but don't suppress) for first-phase rollout. Keep raw events intact.
mohit: Will add annotate-only flag and emergency kill switch.
taylor: Thanks all — follow-ups in RW-10214."
